manifest_row.title: Should my next car be an electric one?

screening.main_topic: A prospective buyer’s assessment of the costs, range, charging access, and practicality of switching from a petrol car to an electric vehicle.
screening.climate_relevance: The article presents electric vehicles as a way to reduce carbon pollution and contribute to an emissions-free future, framing the consumer decision as environmental action.
screening.reason: Although focused on practical EV ownership, the article repeatedly connects the switch from petrol to electric vehicles with reducing pollution, helping the planet, and achieving an emissions-free future. This is meaningful discourse about climate mitigation.
